summary: Completed comprehensive testing of furniture production management application. All backend APIs working correctly with 100% test pass rate. Frontend UI fully functional with proper navigation, CRUD operations, and cost calculations. Minor accessibility warnings found but no functional issues.

design_issues.issue: Missing Description or aria-describedby attributes causing accessibility warnings
affected_selectors: DialogContent in Orders, Materials, and OrderDetail pages

passed_tests: Materials CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Orders CRUD operations with status and client filtering
Cost items addition with automatic calculations
Cost calculation formulas (sale_price = actual_cost * 1.6, cashless_price = cash_price / 0.87)
Calendar API with date range filtering
Orders page search and filtering functionality
Order creation dialog and form submission
Order detail page navigation and display
Materials page search and type filtering
action_item_for_main_agent: Add aria-describedby or Description props to DialogContent components in Orders.jsx, Materials.jsx, and OrderDetail.jsx to resolve accessibility warnings. This is a minor enhancement for better accessibility compliance.
